VIEW_DEFINITION:
create or replace view V_LATEST_ORDER as
select CUSTOMER_ID, ORDER_ID, IFF(TOTAL_AMOUNT > 0, TOTAL_AMOUNT, 0)::NUMBER(12,2) as TOTAL
from ORDERS
qualify row_number() over (partition by CUSTOMER_ID order by ORDER_DATE desc) = 1

create view V_TOP_CUSTOMERS as
-- synthetic: colour from the attributes, 'a:b' in a string is not a path
select c.CUSTOMER_ID, NVL(p.ATTRIBUTES:color::string, 'a:b') as COLOR
from CUSTOMERS c join ORDERS o on o.CUSTOMER_ID = c.CUSTOMER_ID
join ORDER_LINES l on l.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID join PRODUCTS p on p.PRODUCT_ID = l.PRODUCT_ID
order by c.CUSTOMER_ID
limit 10

create view V_PRODUCT_ATTRIBUTES as
select p.PRODUCT_ID, f.key as KEY, f.value as VALUE
from PRODUCTS p,
lateral flatten(input => p.ATTRIBUTES) f

create view V_ORDER_MARGIN as
select ORDER_ID, MARGIN_PCT(TOTAL_AMOUNT) as MARGIN from ORDERS
